item.title: Three TCSS employees nominated for national award
item.description: Three Troup County School System employees are nominated for National Life Group’s 2025-26 LifeChanger of the Year award.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Thomas Knapp: In Politics, the Celebrations Start Early and the Excuses Never End
item.description: A Texas special election has Democrats celebrating and Republicans worrying, but Thomas Knapp argues midterm outcomes will barely alter politics-as-usual.

item.title: Yumi Boba cuts ribbon on square
item.description: Yumi Boba, formerly Ice Queen, opens on LaGrange’s Lafayette Square, serving rolled ice cream, boba and new desserts under owners Christian Villatoro and Elida Alvarado.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Loran Smith: Ginkgo Tree
item.description: Loran Smith explores the ancient ginkgo tree—its roots in dinosaur-era China, survival of Hiroshima and Japan’s 1923 quake, and its striking presence in Athens, Georgia.

item.title: How Much Does It Cost to Build a House in Georgia in 2026
item.description: If you’re planning to build a home in Georgia, one of the first questions you’re likely asking is how much does it cost to build a house in Georgia?

item.title: Motorists can expect detours, delays in downtown LaGrange as road improvement project set to begin
item.description: Road work in downtown LaGrange starts Monday, Feb. 16, at key West Haralson intersections, bringing lane closures, detours and delays.

item.title: City of LaGrange Animal Shelter launches enhanced webpage with AI-powered lost pet reporting tool
item.description: LaGrange Animal Shelter unveils enhanced webpage with AI-powered lost pet tool, letting residents report missing pets online, upload photos and reach 3,200+ partner shelters.

item.title: LaGrange Mayor Arrington, with Wellstar West Georgia Medical Center, announces Spring Mayor’s Health Initiative
item.description: LaGrange Mayor Jim Arrington and Wellstar West Georgia Medical Center launch the Spring Mayor’s Health Initiative, offering free fitness events for all ages February through May.
